name: Panopticon
description: The megacorp that doesn’t just watch you — it knows you better than you know yourself. While others sell you products, Panopticon sells omniscience. Your search history, your dreams, your biometric fluctuations, your late-night Grid scrolls… all fuel the machine.

achievements.title: Panopticon Index Launch
achievements.description: Now processing 8.4 quadrillion queries per second.

achievements.title: Predictive Behavior Mesh
achievements.description: Accurately predicted 94% of civil unrest 11 days before it happened (then sold the data to SecuraCorp).

achievements.title: Project Veil
achievements.description: Every public AR lens, smart mirror, and neural implant now runs Panopticon telemetry by default.

achievements.title: Independent Social Network Acquisition
achievements.description: Acquired the remaining independent social networks in a single weekend. Official statement: 'Consolidation is caring.'

achievements.title: Echo Chamber 2.0
achievements.description: Now custom-tailors reality so perfectly users thank them for it.

flavorText: We don’t just index the world. We own it.
Privacy is a bug. We fixed it.
Your data looks better on our servers.
See everything. Judge everything. Monetize everything.
